annotation_selection: Use source GRD item derived_from links and SAFE-manifest product-annotation references; verify product XML identity, acquisition, orbit, polarization and geolocation support. Do not trust schema-product asset labels alone.
orbit_interpolation: Cubic Hermite interpolation of annotated Earth-fixed position/velocity without extrapolation; geolocation-grid acquisition times and ellipsoidal heights define ground-to-sensor vectors
geometry_interpolation: Linear interpolation of unit Earth-fixed viewing vectors within the annotation-grid convex hull, then normalization; no extrapolation
terrain_method: Use the pinned 30m DSM grid and supported derivatives; account for grid-axis orientation in local east/north surface normals; compute approximate local incidence and local range-order reversal/back-facing facet risks
limitations: Approximate local geometry, not a validated Range-Doppler processor or correction to provider RTC values
Surface model is not bare earth; orthometric slope gradients do not establish exact ellipsoidal surface normals
Local back-facing and range-reversal predicates are risk flags, not a complete nonlocal layover or shadow solution
No ray-traced nonlocal occlusion or trusted-processor agreement; passing local checks never certifies radar illumination
VV annotation supplies approximate dual-polarization geometry; no independent outcome, crop-condition, irrigation, model-training or operational-alert claim
